text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a change to split routing/quota attributes out of console_events into a new route_profiles table. Want to align on dual-write + read-adapter approach before I start backfill.
Dan: +1, rough plan?
Maria: Plan: 1) add route_profiles (route_id, profile_json, last_seen, version) 2) dual-write from ingest (console API) for 2 weeks 3) read-adapter in console that tries route_profiles -> fallback to console_events 4) run backfill job and cutover when metrics look stable.
Kevin: How are we handling quota windows and per-tenant overrides? those are currently denormed into console_events.attrs
Maria: We'll keep windowed quota refs as references in profile_json (small map), not full-timeseries. The timeseries remains in metrics store. We only copy the contract fields needed for console UX and routing.
Sasha: Concern: console queries that JOIN on console_events for recent events — if we migrate fields out we'll need to ensure query plans don't explode. Read-adapter should be cheap.
Dan: We should add a lightweight projection table (profile_lookup) with route_id -> normalized fields used by dashboards (quota_bucket, tier_label) for indexing. That avoids joins.
Tia: Can we do a staged denorm? Start with route_profiles + projection column on console_events (route_profile_id) then populate projection later and purge column after cutover.
Maria: Yep — that's the current idea. Dual-write will write route_profile_id into console_events for a transitional period.
Kevin: Backfill safety: we need idempotency and throttling. Suggest running backfill in tenant batches and sample check p50/p99 for queries before global cutover.
Maria: Agreed. I'll add a throttled job that marks tenants as done. Also will produce a canary dataset of 10 high-traffic tenants for early verification.
Dan: What about consumers besides console (billing, alerts)? They read console_events. Dual-write needs to emit a compatibility envelope for those consumers.
Sasha: I can audit consumers. But immediate plan: keep console_events unchanged for downstreams, only write route_profiles in parallel. Consumers can migrate if they want.
ingest-bot: Reminder: schema migrations require 48h downtime window request to platform-sql for heavy DDLs.
Maria: Not intending heavy DDLs — small table + indexes. Still will file the window to be safe.
Tia: Rollout UX: dashboard team wants zero visual change. We'll add a feature-flag on the console service to toggle read-adapter.
Maria: Yes — read-adapter behind feature flag. Canary: enable for admin role in staging, then 5% of prod traffic, then promote. If we see >0.1% delta in latency or any missing profiles, rollback flag.
Kevin: Metrics: we should monitor per-route profile miss rate, console query p95, and cost delta. Also add quality checks: sample prompt-based UI smoke tests.
Maria: Adding those to the runbook. Also adding a regression alert if route_profile.version diverges across writes.
Dan: SQL snippet for creation (proposal):
```sql
CREATE TABLE route_profiles (
  route_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_json JSONB NOT NULL,
  last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);
CREATE INDEX ON route_profiles (last_seen);
```
Tia: For dual-write, we should append a write-ahead tag so backfills can reconcile with last_write_vsn.
Maria: I'll have the ingest patch add last_write_vsn and route_profile_id. Backfill will upsert using version checks.
Sasha: Ownership and timeline?
Maria: Ownership: Maria (migration lead), Dan (read-adapter + projection table), Kevin (backfill ops), Sasha (consumer audit + query safety), Tia (console feature-flag + QA). Timeline: prototype this week, canary next week, prod cutover in ~3 weeks if canary clean.
Dan: Ping me when prototype ready, I can help validate read-adapter heuristics.
Kevin: I'll schedule backfill infra and reserve window.
Tia: I'll prepare console flag and smoke tests.
Sasha: I'll post a list of known consumers by EOD.
Maria: Thanks — I'll create the PR for DDL + ingest change and the runbook doc. Posting the initial checklist here: 
- create route_profiles table (Maria)
- dual-write patch (ingest) (Maria/Dan)
- add route_profile_id column to console_events (Dan)
- projection table for dashboards (Dan)
- backfill job (Kevin)
- read-adapter behind flag (Dan/Tia)
- consumer audit (Sasha)
- canary tenants (Maria)
- monitoring + alerts (Kevin)

Maria: Any objections?
Dan: None from me. :thumbsup:
Kevin: LGTM
Sasha: Fine by me
Tia: no objections
Maria: Cool — filing the migration RFC and tagging infra for a low-risk DDL window. I'll update thread with PR links. :rocket:
